name: Semantic Camouflage via Fluid Dynamics Terminology
description: Recast the tree-subset problem using fluid dynamics terminology ("reservoirs," "pipes," "standing volume," "flow"). By asking to minimize the total volume of pipes that remain open to allow flow between specific points, models relying on pattern matching may misidentify the problem as a Max Flow / Min Cut, bottleneck routing, or general Steiner Tree task, leading to incorrect or inefficient algorithms, while the underlying structure remains a minimal spanning subtree on a tree.
